evidence.exact_quote: I need to confirm if Jennifer Carpenter *won* or just *was nominated*.
IMAX contributed $12.2 million to the opening weekend gross, with 3D contributing $24 million.
The search results don't explicitly state she won.

Even if she didn't win, the prompt says "the movie for which Jennifer Carpenter received the ... Award". If she received a nomination, the movie is still "The Exorcism of Emily Rose". If she won, it's the same movie.
Jennifer Carpenter MTV Movie Award 2006 Best Frightened Performance
IMAX contributed $12.2 million to the opening weekend gross, with 3D contributing $24 million.
I have sufficient information to answer the question.
with a total weekend gross of $85.1 million; IMAX contributed $12.2 million to the opening weekend gross, with 3D contributing $24 million.
The 3D contribution to the opening weekend gross was $24 million.
